conclusion: Infrastructure fully restored: 5,663 embeddings (1024d), HNSW operational, retrieval functional, chunks intact. However, Gold-V5 evaluation shows SEVERE DRIFT - R@5 dropped from 0.7885 to 0.0000. The reconstructed embeddings are mathematically valid but functionally different from the original vector space. This is expected: NVIDIA e5-v5 API does not guarantee bit-exact reproducibility across calls. The original embeddings are NOT recoverable; the rebuilt space is a new functional equivalent that requires re-benchmarking.
recommendation: Do NOT proceed to R6-C2 (Evidence Candidate Builder) on this rebuilt space. The Director must decide: (a) Accept drift and re-establish baseline on new vectors, (b) Investigate if original embeddings exist elsewhere (unlikely per R6-RECOVERY-1), (c) Re-train/fine-tune retrieval for new vector space.
